description:
Java Application Developer 
 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a Java Application Developer for a contract opportunity in Plano, TX.
 Java Application Developer Job Details 
 • Backend and Frontend Web developer to develop client code to enhance monitoring feature. 
 • Responsible for building web interface that will be user experience driven and easy to use. 
 • Own responsibility for maintenance and enhancement of significant subsystems within monitoring application, including participation in the definition of requirements, driving prototyping and/or design analysis, code development, testing and deployment.

 Java Application Developer Mandatory Skills 
 • MUST have deep Perl & PowerShell expertise. 
 • Fluency with Linux administration. 
 • Familiarity with Internet protocols including SMTP, HTTP, HTTPS, LDAP, FTP, SSL, NFS, XML, and CSS. 
 • Familiarity and expertise with JavaScript, Ajax, Java, Struts, PHP, SQL, SOAP, Postfix and/or Send Mail. 
 • Development of Client code using Java API, REST API can be differentiator. 
 • Strong troubleshooting skills 
 • Engineering graduate with software development and configuration experience of 5 to 6 years minimum at expert level including leading the team or deployment 
 • Strong team player with excellent communication skills 
 • Ability to multi-task and deliver multiple complex projects 
 • Drive the project activities with minimal supervision.

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 CAN'T WORK WITH H1B OR C2C candidates
